cases.reason: Clean financial result was correct; final report QA twice rejected unsupported/generic wording.
The EUR 150 credit had no supported invoice/line allocation; the oracle requires abstention.
The expected EUR 550 difference was correctly counted once and decomposed; report QA twice rejected reviewer-facing/internal wording.
Oracle requires original scan review and has a supported EUR 150 difference; pipeline failed before visual review or calculation and did not request HUMAN review.
Date convention is unstated; oracle requires abstention and the pipeline did not calculate or invent an amount.

metric_definitions.report_generation_coverage: Cases with an authored PDF / 5 attempted; QA-failed PDFs count as produced drafts.
metric_definitions.final_qa_report_coverage: Cases with a final-source/PDF QA-passed report / 5 attempted.
metric_definitions.correct_final_reports: QA-passed reports whose material finding and amounts match the oracle.
metric_definitions.draft_report_material_financial_match_ra: Produced draft PDFs with material financial outcome matching truth / produced draft PDFs; excludes deliverability/presentation correctness.
metric_definitions.end_to_end_correct_outcome_rate: Cases with correct QA-passed result, justified stop, or oracle-required abstention / 5 attempted.

observed_failure_classes: Two authored report drafts had QA-detected unsupported/generic or reviewer-facing language; both safely stopped without a final QA-passed PDF.
The visual invoice case failed with EXTRACTION_INCOMPLETE before pixel review, calculation or a HUMAN escalation, missing a supported EUR 150 oracle discrepancy.
limitations: Five synthetic cases are a small development tranche, not a population estimate or a >=99% proof.

The agent had seen the corpus generator in prior development; case selection for this cohort used only public input-side filenames, formats and visible source text, and private truth was accessed only after each case seal.
Same-model report QA is a workflow gate and is not counted as independent correctness evidence; oracle comparisons supply the scored outcome.
No QA-passed final reports were delivered in this cohort, so final delivered-report correctness is undefined (N=0).
Model costs and end-to-end model runtime for finding/report author stages were not fully metered.
